decisions: Work in the requested existing directory; no commit or push, preserve sibling state.
Managed payload and record counts are measured, not process RSS; exclusions are explicit in docs/resources.md.
Trace events remain charged until close; observing a run must not steal its mandatory native prepare working set.
C PC concrete service structs now have ABI2 and require recompilation; core ABI and callback tables remain version1.
limitations: PC only; no RV32 or board DMA/cache/FENCE validation.
Original Python ModelPackage/weights bytes, Python wrappers/containers, offline workspaces, libc and caller-owned copies are outside this managed runtime payload budget.
Inspect array working set is an explicit reservation, not measured total thread stack.
Third-party backends must opt into resource tracking; no automatic measurement of arbitrary native allocations.
Independent review was not repeated after author fixes.
No model or W4A8 binding, no S6 implementation, no Git publication.
